title: Three Planted-Defect Entries
description: The start of calibration_drafts.json. Each entry records a draft, the defect you planted in it, and a short description, so you know the right verdict before the critic sees it.

steps.description: This is `calibration_drafts.json`, a JSON array. Each entry records the draft, the defect you planted, and a short description. `D01` has defect `missing_C4` and the description `No example provided`.
`D02` has defect `missing_C2_and_C3` and the description `No parameter or return descriptions`. The defect string names the two criteria it breaks.
`D03` has defect `none` and the description `Defect-free draft`. The page says you can see false positives only if the set includes drafts with nothing wrong, so include some.
